answer: Only count a pass toward Established if the graders who voted pass signed up at least 30 epochs apart, oldest to youngest. The answer still gets paid, it just doesn't build standing. Panels drawn from the whole pool clear that bar almost every time, so honest authors won't notice. Say a farm registers 40 accounts in one night, sable-01 to sable-40, and they keep passing each other's crystal shop pitches. Those passes all come from accounts born the same day, so none count. To fake the spread the farm has to sit on idle accounts over a 30-epoch horizon, about a week of real time.
